newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends steady on support from States.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends steady on support from States.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended steady on Tuesday, still drawing support from a healthy U.S. appetite and tighter local supplies, traders and brokers said.
One broker said the cargo market was quiet but prices had notionally headed higher and sellers of larger cargoes were looking to the U.S.
"(The arbitrage) is pretty much there," he said. "It's sufficient with big pieces to look to the States instead of Europe."
Eurograde barges ended roughly unchanged at $216.$217 fob ARA, after trading as low at $215.50 and as high as $218.25, brokers said.
Bids for premium unleaded cargoes were heard at $218 cif and offers in the low $220s, and at $210 fob for bids and $212 for offers.
"There is material but the sellers on a fixed price are too high," the broker said.
